metadata.title: Curio
metadata.tagline: Things you chose not to forget
metadata.summary: A quiet personal library for the things you choose not to forget.
metadata.overview: Curio is a personal library for the things you choose not to forget. Instead of asking you to organize everything with folders and tags, Curio explores how the things we save can become dynamic threads ofcuriosity that evolve and connect over time.
metadata.why: Curio began with a simple question: what if saving something wasn't about organizing it, but simplyabout choosing not to lose it? The project explores a quieter, more personal way of keeping things from the internet and from everyday life.
lessons: Designing a system around user intent rather than rigid organization.
Exploring how saved things can form meaningful connections.
